```lean
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength hi)
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rewrite [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength hu)
      (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rewrite [List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength hu), List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength hi)]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
```

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rw [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    have hd := UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
    simp [hn k hk'] at hd

  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := fun hu hi =>
  let hl := UpdateStatesLength hu

  ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit il

    cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
    unfold updatedStates

    simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
  ⟩

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := fun hu hi =>
  let hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  let := InitStatesLength hi
  ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), by
    cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
    unfold updatedStates
    rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate hl
        (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
    simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
  ⟩

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := fun hu hi =>
  let hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  let := InitStatesLength hi
  ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), by
    cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
    unfold updatedStates
    rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate hl
        (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
    simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
  ⟩

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := fun hu hi =>
  let hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  let := InitStatesLength hi
  ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), by
    cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
    unfold updatedStates
    rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate hl
        (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
    simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
  ⟩
